summary: A helper arrives for the earliest stop expecting empty space and finds people already waiting.
realLife: William Bray recalled a large crowd waiting before dawn at Truman's early stop at Rock Island, Illinois, and told Truman that people willing to get up so early were at least willing to listen.
inGame: needs: scheduled hour and observed attendance.

turns.what: The host tells the candidate what happened before arrival.
turns.writesBack: The candidate knows why the early turnout mattered.

turns.pulledBy: Few people could come before work.
turns.what: The host records the turnout without treating it as a vote count.
turns.writesBack: The next organizer gets the actual hour and attendance.
